_comment: Constrained single-objective search: minimise net_cost subject to the emissions, utility, and cost-floor constraints below (both fractions relative to BAU, cumulative over the whole policy period).

constraints._comment: Both fractions are one-sided bounds vs. BAU — exceeding them (more decarbonisation, smaller utility loss) is fine and unconstrained; only the stated direction is enforced. net_cost_floor is the minimum acceptable net_cost (default 0: a policy can't be net income) — see optimisation.py.

search._comment: LHS + BO evaluation budget, both Phase 2 only (see run.py module docstring for the compute-cost breakdown).
